title: harden cvg update i18n — coverage test and missing keys
task_body: cvg update was emitting raw English in places that should localise. Add a coverage test that asserts every visible string flows through the Fluent bundle, fix the missing keys in en/it, and route update_run through the bundle.
rationale: update_run is the offender; the cli_update test validates strings; en/it Fluent bundles gain the missing keys; the i18n coverage test enforces the rule.
